review: I translate for a living and I have translated worship lyrics into Hungarian for my congregation for four years, unpaid and unasked and uncredited, and my pastor uses them every Sunday and has never named me from the front. So I listen to this catalog professionally. "Alte Worte sprechen noch" is a genuinely good German lyric — the internal rhyme survives, which almost never survives, which means somebody wrote it in German rather than translating it into German. That is the whole difference and I would like to know how you did it, because I am the person on the other end of that problem and there is nothing in Hungarian at all.
